params.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

ALCHY — LAST ROUND.
Preserve the exact illustrated adult man: tousled brown hair and beard, open dark-red short-sleeved shirt with white stripes, white tank, gold pendant, dark gray trousers, brown loafers and bottle wrapped in a brown paper bag. Preserve face and proportions.
0–0.7s: establish his full body in an impossibly deep backward lean, one hand open and the other keeping the bagged bottle perfectly upright. It looks as though he has nothing left, then his eyes sharpen.
0.7–2.4s: he whips forward out of the lean into a giant springing upward palm strike. A huge amber-gold liquid dragonlike spiral follows his motion, camera rockets back to show it looping completely around him before BURSTING into an enormous rising fist-shaped wave. Clearly a comeback surge of magical liquid energy; bottle stays intact and upright, no person struck, no ground or scenery. Freeze briefly on the enormous peak.
2.4–3.5s: SNAP-PUSH into his suddenly confident grin as exact title "LAST ROUND" slams into two clear comic lines.
3.5–5s: he casually catches one last amber drop on the bottle's rim, straightens his shirt and holds a triumphant, slightly surprised pose; title stays legible. The joke is the impossible recovery without spilling his bottle. Sound: elastic windup, huge accelerating liquid whoosh, heavy comeback impact, title slam, tiny final drop. No drinking sequence, speech or music. Five seconds total.

ATL SCAMMER — PENDING TRANSFER.
Preserve the exact illustrated adult man with short twists, thin mustache/goatee, black hooded tracksuit with broad white stripes, white shirt, gold jewelry, chunky black-white sneakers. Keep the handful of receipts and open takeaway box of sauced wings with lemon.
0–0.7s: establish full body; he looks innocently over one shoulder while keeping his food level, then fans the receipts with a mischievous wrist flick.
0.7–2.4s: receipts explode into a colossal spiraling paper funnel. Camera races through the ring as a floating golden energy token is caught and redirected around him; he casually draws one receipt backward and the entire funnel folds into a giant glowing hourglass-shaped paper seal. Huge black-white-gold burst at its center. Magical satirical powers only, no actual banking interfaces, account information or instructions, no readable receipt data.
2.4–3.5s: SNAP-PUSH to his smug expression as exact title "PENDING TRANSFER" slams into two large comic lines and the energy token lands in his receipt hand.
3.5–5s: he tucks that receipt away and tilts the intact food box toward himself with a satisfied grin, utterly unconcerned while one absurdly long receipt continues unrolling behind his shoulder. Hold clear character, food and title. Sound: receipt snap, accelerating paper tornado, magical token chime, huge seal impact, title slam, long paper flutter. No speech or music; resolve in five seconds.

HUGE concentric ivory-and-gold sonic rings rocket outward; camera pulls rapidly backward revealing the little seated baby at the center of an absurdly large expanding sound-wave structure. Tiny floating paper-airplane shapes harmlessly cartwheel in the wake. The infant stays safely supported in the intact chair; no impact, injury, violent chair movement or distress realism. Ink-edged rings with clear cyan gaps, no full-frame flash or background panel.

3.5–5s: the baby instantly stops, opens big innocent eyes and lets out a small satisfied giggle as the very last tiny sound ring pops. A paper airplane gently lands on the chair arm. Hold the complete safe seated character and title. Sound: comical inhalation, stylized nonverbal baby wail mixed as a punchy sonic effect rather than painful shrill noise, bassy ring pulses, title slam, tiny giggle/pop. No words, music, airplane emergency or other voices. Five seconds total.

BBL DEMON — PROBLEM ENERGY.
Preserve the exact illustrated adult demon woman: long flowing black hair, red eyes, two red curved horns, silver hoop earrings, black fitted top, cropped red/black varsity jacket with flame/demon pattern, red cargo trousers with chains and black buckled platform boots. 0–1.2s: full-body slow confident stance; she rolls a tiny red-violet flame between two fingertips and raises one eyebrow as if deciding how much trouble to cause.

Camera pulls rapidly far back and tilts upward to show their outrageous scale while leaving cyan visible through and around them; no scenery or solid background.
3.2–4.8s: she casually snaps her fingers. The halos collide into an enormous horned theatrical-mask emblem split between a grin and a scowl, then erupt in layered red-gold shockwaves and sharp black ink petals.
